read_scope: Only frozen source/template plus previously executed independent toy-math receipt. AST parse and literal configuration inspection only; producer not imported or executed.
pass_reasons: Exact finite posterior branches retain every strictly positive rational-probability outcome. The adaptive solver scores each affordable proxy separately within each posterior branch, takes the max inside the expectation and retains branch-specific selected actions.

All compared methods use the same integer-tick budget3 and per-action costs. Cost1/2 creates forbidden2+2pairs; both loop and cached solvers mask them before maximizing. Each first action must have at least one affordable continuation.
Fixed-pair values are explicitly distinct from adaptive values; full F is not used as a substitute for retained posterior branches.
Fully cached vectorized and blocked-vectorized implementations are present. Explicit kernel-rebuilding loop is labelled correctness-only, not a novel-algorithm performance baseline.
Homogeneous-scaling/dense-uninformative families additionally expose the separable analytic-ranking shortcut, preventing naive-loop speedup claims.
Three families at two sizes give6 bounded one-shot timing cases; include preparation, use1BLASthread, record managed tracemalloc memory, explicitly avoid universal speed/RSS claims.
Runner does not repeat independent CDF/energy quadratures; it hashes and reuses the exact prior65c1a453 receipt.
No raw data/gzip/NPZ/ACTIONS reader, target trainer or material import exists in these two frozen source files. Parent CLI reads only approved plan/approval/source and prior mathematical receipt.
interpretation_required_before_execution: Benchmark action-specific sigma/scale and costs describe different candidate targets under a SUM of local CRPS risks; changing scale across actions is not a proxy-dependent marginal variance for one common target.

Assume each candidate proxy contributes only its local candidate-target risk reduction in this one-proxy horizon, conditional on the shared finite relation. This is a synthetic decision abstraction, not certified real instrument cost.

The same-F binary example is correctly a separate binary proper-score fixture. Our independent full-joint enumeration already confirms its9/64vs7/64 adaptive gains; production short-form arithmetic is not counted as a new independent proof.

Scope booleans state model assumptions and cannot certify real unit independence or source lineage. No material efficacy, new algorithm, screening or speed superiority follows from the6principles/6timingcases.
